Question 2
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫Cx2yds, where C is the section of the polar curve r=2 for −π4≤θ≤π4?

a
2∫−π/4π/4sin⁡θcos2⁡θdθ
b
4∫−π/4π/4sin⁡θcos2⁡θdθ
c
2∫−π/4π/4sin2⁡θcos⁡θdθ
d
4∫−π/4π/4sin⁡θcos⁡θdθ
e
22∫−π/4π/4sin⁡θcos⁡θdθ
